subject: Formalizing a development plan for Ethan — next steps & legal review
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Ethan Park <ethan_park@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Formalizing a development plan for Ethan — next steps & legal review

Team —

Over the last two quarters we've documented several performance gaps with Ethan (missing SLAs on two shipping sprints, recurring quality issues on model integration tests). I've attached a short summary of feedback and a draft plan I put together this morning. My ask: can HR + Legal help formalize the timeline and language so we can start a focused development plan next week if appropriate.

Proposed highlights (draft):
- 90-day focused development plan with weekly checkpoints
- Clear success criteria tied to deliverables (two on-call rotations without critical incidents, parity on integration test coverage for module X)
- Dedicated mentor time (1:1 with senior engineer) and task-level coaching
- Escalation path if metrics do not improve at 4-week and 8-week checkpoints

I want to be fair and supportive — I plan to run this as a performance support plan rather than punitive. Ethan, I'm including you on this thread because I want transparency about process and next steps.

Attachments: redwood_pip_template_v3.docx (docx), supporting_feedback_summary.pdf (pdf)

Thanks —
Karthik
Director of Engineering
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ethan Park <ethan_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Formalizing a development plan for Ethan — next steps & legal review

Thanks Karthik — I reviewed the summary and your draft plan. High level: the structure looks good and aligns with our support-first approach. A few notes from People Ops:

- We should schedule a private 1:1 with Ethan this week to review the plan before any formal paperwork is shared (transparency + opportunity for input).
- Add an explicit coaching log to capture weekly action items and outcomes (this helps with fairness and documentation).
- Include a training objective tied to a measurable artifact (e.g., test coverage increase for module X by 20%).

I'll take your draft and apply the standard template language (tone, appeals/response timelines). Laura — can you confirm any legal phrasing we should avoid around termination triggers and confidentiality?

Ethan — I'm available for a 30-minute sync tomorrow at 10:00 or 15:30 — Let me know what works.

Best,
Marissa
Senior People Partner
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Ethan Park <ethan_park@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 13:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Formalizing a development plan for Ethan — next steps & legal review

Thanks for the heads-up. I skimmed the draft and supporting feedback. Two legal items to flag:

1) Language around "termination triggers" — avoid deterministic phrasing (e.g., "will be terminated if X occurs"). We recommend "insufficient progress may result in termination" plus a defined opportunity to remediate and an appeal window.

2) Data retention / disclosure: if the plan references customer-impact incidents, redact customer PII from the supporting documentation and ensure copies are stored in the secured HR folder (we have a template folder under our shared drive).

I'll draft suggested language and send a redline by EOD. Marissa — once you and Karthik confirm the coaching goals we can finalize.

Laura
General Counsel, Redwood Inference

To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Karthik / Marissa / Laura —

Thanks for including me. I appreciate the upfront context. I'm open to the plan and would like to provide some background on the test coverage work — I hit unexpected infra instability that I didn't realize was causing flakes. I can document the incidents and proposed mitigation steps in the coaching log.

I'm available for the 10:00 slot tomorrow with Marissa. My goal is to work with you all to get clear success criteria so I can concentrate on the improvements.

— Ethan
